messages:
lina: FYI I'm opening intake for a new model: vireo-8b. asking for quick triage: perf baseline, quant feasibility, and docs owner.

matt: Sounds good. can someone run a 1k-token throughput smoke (+latency p50/p95) on a small batch on a gtx-like config?

keisha: I can run smoke and initial eval today. will compare against our current canonical 7b baseline (latency + tox).

oliver: Heads up on quant: this arch tends to degrade under naive int4. propose trying qlora-style ptq -> awq -> int8 fallback chain.

jamie: For prioritization: product requested optional for search re-ranker. score: medium priority. if we see no quality drop on int8, we can schedule catalog add earlier.

lina: Priority noted. checklist I'm proposing: 1) smoke perf on staging 2) eval suite (toxicity, instr-follow, MMLU subset) 3) quant pipeline experiments 4) catalog entry draft + inference shape docs 5) announce + release plan

keisha: I'll kick off eval suite: linking eval harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/tree/main/vireo-harness 

keisha: first pass numbers (wip): MMLU subset - 67.8 vs baseline 69.1; instruction-follow qualitatively similar; minor drop on multi-hop QA.

oliver: Interesting. send logits diff for the failing cases? might be beam-decoding differences.

keisha: Uploaded diffs and a short repro in the repo. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/652

matt: On quant experiments: try this config as starting point:```json
{"quant_method":"awq","bits":8,"group_size":128,"fallback":"int8"}```

oliver: Will run AWQ int8 + int4 post-training transform later today. will post perf/cost numbers.

jamie: Docs: assign docs owner? lina can you own catalog draft and I'll take the announcement blurb once we have numbers.

lina: I can own the catalog entry. Draft path: docs/models/vireo-8b.md. I'll stub fields: model card, perf tables, quant recommendations, known regressions.

docs-bot: Template created: docs/models/vireo-8b.md -> PR branch vireo-catalog-draft

keisha: Quick note on eval thresholds: I think we should gate catalog launch if instr-follow drops >2 pts from baseline or MMLU >3 pts. otherwise we can add with a "beta" label and note quant caveats.

matt: Agree. also add latency SLO checks: p95 must be <=1.6x baseline for hosted mode or we don't onboard to hosted catalog.

lina: Noted. I'll add gating criteria to the PR description.

oliver: AWQ int8 run finished: latency +12% p95, cost ~-28%, instr-follow delta -0.9, MMLU delta -1.3. int4 experiment failing on math cases, heavy regressions.

keisha: Those numbers look acceptable for beta with docs caveat. I'll add examples to regression section.

jamie: Release plan suggestion: canary on Dedicated for 48h with 5% traffic -> verify metrics -> promote to hosted beta with opt-in flag -> public announce after 1 week stable.

lina: Good plan. timeline: canary by EOD Thu, hosted beta Mon, public announce Fri next week (tentative).

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy vireo-8b-awq-int8 -> dedicated-pool-3 at 2026-04-02T18:00Z

eval-bot: Automated eval run complete (canary snapshot). no critical regressions; flagged 12 borderline cases for docs.

matt: Please make sure rollout playbook includes rollback criteria: >3% user-visible regressions or error-rate spike +10%

lina: Agreed. adding rollback steps to the release playbook.

jamie: I'll prepare announcement copy once docs PR is merged. ping me when PR is ready for a review. :tada:

lina: Thanks everyone — I'll post the PR links once the catalog draft is up and update the timeline. :wave:
